areas.name: Archival Route
areas.location_cue: The Enterrise cabinet, model plate, three reels, controls, main display, lighting, speakers, and service record.
areas.note: Complete the original cabinet; preserve mobile simulators as supplemental evidence and keep later specifications separate.

levels.1: The selected route uses the first 2017 amusement machine.
levels.2: Use an authentic Enterrise cabinet.
levels.3: Verify model plate, shell, reels, controls, display, lights, firmware, and service record. Do not substitute Into the Panic or either later pachinko specification.

levels.1: A portrait mobile simulator reproduces cabinet systems.
levels.2: Archive an owned iOS copy separately.
levels.3: Record package, version, device, operating system, controls, menus, available modes, saved state, audio, and differences from hardware. Use it to test only after preserving the cabinet record.

levels.1: A matching Android simulator was released.
levels.2: Archive a lawful Android package separately.
levels.3: Record signature, version, device or emulator, controls, menus, modes, saves, audio, and hardware differences. Do not treat forced states as naturally observed cabinet results.

levels.1: Several later machines reuse the property.
levels.2: Exclude Into the Panic, CRF, and PF Light Version from this route.
levels.3: Photograph any encountered model plate and keep its captures in a separate archive. Never merge its reels, mode rules, probabilities, awards, or cabinet hardware.

levels.1: Completion never requires wagering.
levels.2: Use lawful private non-wager free play.
levels.3: Have an authorized owner prepare the cabinet from operator documentation. Do not deposit money, seek payouts, bypass safety systems, or use public gambling to reach content.

levels.1: Reels, controls, screen, lights, and audio act together.
levels.2: Record the whole cabinet continuously.
levels.3: Start before power-on and preserve every input, reel stop, display transition, lamp, speaker cue, counter, result, and reset in one uncut master.
